text:
incident-bot: [P1 Pager] GPU autoscaler alert: eu-west GPU pool saturated; autoscaler failing to scale (repeated backoff). Queue length > 1200. Triggered 2026-03-17T01:22Z :rotating_light:
monica_oncall: grabbing oncall, joining bridge in 1m. pinging @irene_sre @sam_engineer. bridge https://meet.company/abc123
irene_sre: looking at autoscaler logs now. I see ScaleUpAttempt stuck in backoff, and repeated provider 4xx responses. pulling more logs.
sam_engineer: provider API returning 403/429 on CreateInstance calls. suspect per-AZ quota or soft capacity limit. sample logs:
```
2026-03-17T01:21:44Z scale_manager.go:234 Attempting CreateInstance(zone=eu-west-2a)
2026-03-17T01:21:44Z cloudapi.go:512 Response 403 {"error":"capacity_exceeded","message":"No available instance in zone"}
2026-03-17T01:21:46Z scale_manager.go:240 Backoff for 30s
2026-03-17T01:22:10Z scale_manager.go:234 Attempting CreateInstance(zone=eu-west-2b)
2026-03-17T01:22:10Z cloudapi.go:512 Response 429 {"error":"rate_limit","message":"region allocation throttled"}
```
leo_support: customers are seeing timeouts and elevated 5xx on /v1/generate. Support tickets #3421 #3422 flagged P1. Affected tenants include a couple on free tier + some paying customers in EU.
monica_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) soft-rate-limit non-SLA tenants in eu-west to 50% of normal; 2) roll fallback to smaller quantized model for non-SLA traffic to reduce GPU memory/throughput; 3) attempt manual provisioning in eu-central spare pool for cross-region failover. executing steps now. :arrow_right_hook:
deploy-bot: starting rollout: `redwood deploy --route /generate --model rwd/gpt-small-quant --percent 30 --region eu-west` -> kicked off. will report when at 30%.
sam_engineer: opened cloud support ticket with provider (case 998234) requesting quota increase / AZ capacity check. ETA from provider support ~ 30-45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
irene_sre: applying cache eviction to free GPU memory for long-running sessions. running:
```
kubectl -n runtime exec svc/cache-evictor -- /bin/sh -c "evict-kv-prefix --age>24h"
```
jordan_pm: Jordan here — drafting customer status update. need impact numbers + ETA for next update.
monica_oncall: quick numbers: eu-west request latency 95p up 2-6x, error rate spiked to ~14% for eu-west; global proportion of impacted requests ~8%. will update in 10m after fallback progress.
leo_support: posting initial status on status.redwood.com and replying to the open tickets with the incident link.
irene_sre: autoscaler backoff metric is noise: adding an explicit alert for consecutive provider 4xx/5xx during scale operations (threshold = 3 errors within 2m). filing PR for alert rules.
sam_engineer: manual cross-region failover started: shifting 20% eu-west traffic to eu-central pool via routing override. command: `redwood route update --from-region eu-west --to-region eu-central --percent 20`
monica_oncall: fallback rollout at 30% complete, observed ~18% reduction in GPU queue length so far. keep ramping to 50% if provider ETA slips.
deploy-bot: fallback rollout to 50% complete. traffic shift executed. logs show model throughput improved and queue drain rate increased.
jordan_pm: good — I'll include model fallback note in customer update. drafting now.
monica_oncall: current mitigation status: rate-limits + fallback + partial cross-region shift. provider ticket open. impact decreasing but still monitoring. no full outage to customers but degraded performance for some EU tenants.
monica_oncall: action items while oncall: (1) @sam_engineer -> escalate provider quota case and request hard quota bump + follow up with sales for large tenants; (2) @irene_sre -> add autoscaler provider-error alert + run capacity drillbook; (3) @deploy-bot -> create postmortem stub and link to incident; (4) @leo_support -> consolidate impacted tenant list and send comms draft.
sam_engineer: acknowledged. will attach provider responses to the cloud ticket and paste here.
irene_sre: opened PR for alert rules (link pasted to channel) and added short-term playbook steps for manual scale and fallback.
deploy-bot: created postmortem issue: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RI-5678 with initial timeline and owners.
monica_oncall: moving to monitoring phase. will hand off to follow-up owning rotation in 2h for postmortem. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: postmortem checklist in the issue: timeline, root-cause hypothesis, mitigation, action items (autoscaler alerting, fallback automation, capacity-runbooks). tagging @oncall-rotation for follow-up.
monica_oncall: final note — temporary mitigations: keep fallback routing enabled for next 24h until provider confirms capacity, and run a capacity drill to validate autoscaler behavior under quota errors. assigning @irene_sre and @sam_engineer.
monica_oncall: closing live triage thread. will follow up in postmortem with RCA and next steps. :lock:
